claims.text: Chronic pain: TCAs are useful, as in other chronic pain syndromes, and well tolerated (first exclude flank pain needing intervention: infection, stone, zoster, neoplasm).
claims.quote: Flank pain from other causes that may require intervention, such as infection, stone, herpes zoster, and neoplasms, should be excluded. Tricyclic antidepressants are useful, as in other chronic pain syndromes, and are well tolerated.
